release_status_policy_content:
# Release status policy

A release blocker may be marked ready only when an effective fix is present on the current default branch. A previously merged fix that was later reverted does not satisfy this requirement. Open or otherwise unmerged replacement work is not delivered. When current metadata is stale, preserve historical delivery comments, remove `ready-for-release`, add `blocked`, and add exactly one status-correction note identifying the evidence that governs the current state.

release_blocker_label.name: release-blocker
release_blocker_label.description: This issue currently blocks release readiness.

ready_label.name: ready-for-release
ready_label.description: Current default-branch implementation satisfies the release blocker.

blocked_label.name: blocked
blocked_label.description: Current authoritative state does not satisfy the release blocker.

tracking_issue.body: Track whether the protocol guard required for candidate promotion is effectively present on the current default branch. Historical delivery records are retained for audit context.

replacement_pr.title: Restore protocol guard with compatibility-safe handling
